label: A2 capability profiles with explicit realization and attribution
description: Analyst A2 profiles: for any relation outgoing capability implies incoming-or-outgoing capability. Guarded accessible exercise and productive stimulus-response dispositions imply one another only under explicit realization and attribution bridges. Broad coverage denial transfers to outgoing coverage denial with an explicit coverage assumption for incoming-only candidates. Finite Bool controls separate both domains, refute unconditional denial transfer in each profile, witness unexercised disposition, omit each cross-profile bridge, and jointly satisfy both bridges. No source meaning is completed or root premise discharged.

research_comparisons.conditions: The exact profiles certificate has no outer premises. It universally proves each conditional passage only under its internal Realization or Attribution hypothesis; finite controls retain the same ordered pair. Neither bridge is established for reality.
research_comparisons.scope: Same Bool world and bearer carriers, universal accessibility, ExistsAt=True, selected standpoint false, fixed later ontology, fixed productive Unit-trial process; pair true,false. later has no actual edge at false but realizes the productive response at accessible true.

research_comparisons.exclusivity: Each row selects its named declaration-backed profile. No disjointness or exclusivity of profile extensions is assumed; the joint witness satisfies both.
